TwemojiCountryFlags.woff2
=========================

A COLRv1 web font containing the country-flag glyphs of Twemoji and nothing
else. It exists because Microsoft's Segoe UI Emoji ships no national flags, so
on Windows the Regional Indicator pairs that make up a flag emoji render as two
letters. Loaded from styles.css with `unicode-range: U+1F1E6-1F1FF`, so it is
consulted for those code points only.

Font build
----------
Taken from the `country-flag-emoji-polyfill` package by TalkJS
(https://github.com/talkjs/country-flag-emoji-polyfill), file
`dist/TwemojiCountryFlags.woff2` of version 0.1.8. The package's own code is
MIT licensed; only the font file is used here, not the polyfill script.

  sha256  9f04f14429bb6a9f415c7a4dd902a918d7e81a4f7526c415496fdb063954e3b8
  size    78292 bytes
